answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to forge a reputation bond before trading: the agent locks a small stake and earns trust only through verified work over time, like a tide that rises slowly and cannot be rushed. A fable identity with no history carries near-zero weight, so an attacker must pay the stake and wait through many real transactions for every fake account, making mass fakery expensive while honest newcomers can still join by starting small.
